summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented but unverified: I did not run tests, per your instructions. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (json. prefix, one combined pattern); rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* keys; rich/json.py adds the JSON renderable and a __main__ CLI; rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print; rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json before inspect. Tests were appended to tests/test_console.py and tests/test_rich_print.py, and docs/changelog were updated. Deviations to check: overflow is set to None because "none" is not a valid OverflowMethod; Console.print still crops to console width by default, so long lines are not wrapped but can be cut off unless soft_wrap is set; the CLI imports Console inside its __main__ guard; run it as python -m rich.json, not python rich/json.py. Nothing was committed.
